I'm a Shopify Developer / Shopify Plus Developer / Shopify & Shopify Plus Expert with over 11+ years of experience.

✅ Development of Custom Shopify Bundles with individual SKUs for seamless third-party logistics
✅ End-to-end Shopify & Shopify Plus store design and development using FIGMA or Adobe XD files
✅ Shopify & Shopify Plus Theme customization
✅ Building custom Shopify themes
✅ Advanced functionality development for Shopify stores
✅ Integration of third-party apps and APIs with Shopify
✅ Liquid coding for Shopify customization
✅ App integration and custom app development
✅ Custom programming to enhance Shopify stores
✅ Shopify Store Conversion Optimization
✅ Shopify Speed Optimization
✅ Shopify Admin and back-end management
✅ Shopify 2.0 Migration and Upgrades
✅ And much more!
